items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And I'd cook or MARALEE'S would cook. And we were really a foursome.

ctx.x: Yes. And see in California, like he tells everybody, he tells everybody. He says, we had to see each other, talk to each other every day and we'd have dinner together. And I'd cook or MARALEE'S would cook. And we were really a foursome. And on Thanksgiving we had a dinner at their home and ever Oh Christmas they had dinner over at our home. It was an annual affair.
Yes. MARALEE'S mother and father would come.
